tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Sound And Ultrasound

questions.question: Foundation State the range of frequencies that humans can hear.
questions.correctAnswer: Q1: Humans can hear frequencies between 20 Hz and 20,000 Hz (20 kHz).
questions.explanation: Answer: Q1: Humans can hear frequencies between 20 Hz and 20,000 Hz (20 kHz).

questions.question: Higher A sonar pulse returns after 1.2 s. The speed of sound in water is 1500 m/s. Calculate the depth of the water.
questions.correctAnswer: Q3: Total distance = 1500 × 1.2 = 1800 m. Depth = 1800 ÷ 2 = 900 m
questions.explanation: Answer: Q3: Total distance = 1500 × 1.2 = 1800 m. Depth = 1800 ÷ 2 = 900 m

questions.question: Foundation A person shouts at a cliff and hears the echo 2.0 s later. The speed of sound in air is 330 m/s. How far away is the cliff?
questions.correctAnswer: Q5: Total distance = 330 × 2.0 = 660 m. Distance to cliff = 660 ÷ 2 = 330 m
questions.explanation: Answer: Q5: Total distance = 330 × 2.0 = 660 m. Distance to cliff = 660 ÷ 2 = 330 m
